# AI Voice Agency

> AVA answers your phone. Every call. Books the job.

AVA is a done-for-you AI receptionist service from AI Voice Agency, based in Kewaskum, Wisconsin. AVA answers business phone lines 24/7, qualifies callers, books appointments into the business calendar, and sends text confirmations to the caller and the owner.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-01

## Pricing

- Pricing: AVA starts at $497 per month on your existing phone number, month to month. The full price is given in writing on a 15-minute call before anything starts.
- The base price covers every call answered, jobs put on the business calendar, a confirmation text to the customer, a text and an email to the owner with the job, every call recorded and written out, and a dashboard with every call.
- Limousine and black car companies run on AI Chauffeur (https://aichauffeur.ai), from $997 per month.
- CRM and scheduling software connections are scoped on a call. AVA connects to anything with an API.

## Sample calls

Five recorded sample calls play on the homepage with a job ticket that fills in as the call goes. They are scripted scenarios with sample data and recorded voices, not customer recordings. Full transcripts are on the homepage.

- [Limousine: airport ride sent to dispatch](https://aivoiceagency.ai/audio/samples/v3/limousine.mp3): AVA takes the whole trip, sends the trip sheet to dispatch, and tells the caller dispatch will confirm.
- [Plumbing: leaking water heater](https://aivoiceagency.ai/audio/samples/v3/plumbing.mp3): the visit lands on the calendar and the text reaches the customer before the call ends.
- [Heating and cooling: AC out](https://aivoiceagency.ai/audio/samples/v3/heating.mp3): a priority note goes to the technician and the customer record is saved.
- [Dental: new patient with a toothache](https://aivoiceagency.ai/audio/samples/v3/dental.mp3): a new patient lands on the doctor's schedule and the new patient form is sent.
- [Electrical: live transfer to the owner](https://aivoiceagency.ai/audio/samples/v3/transfer.mp3): AVA checks the call is safe, takes the details, briefs the owner, and puts the caller through.

## The questions operators ask

- AVA picks up in one ring, any hour of the day.
- Then it does the receptionist's real job: it books the appointment into your calendar or routes the call by your rules.
- The caller gets a confirmation text. You get a summary the moment it lands.
- We launch AVA on your existing line, and your forwarding rules decide what it takes: every call, after-hours only, or just the overflow when your team is already on the phone.
- Does AVA replace my receptionist or dispatcher? No. AVA covers what they physically can't: 2 AM, Sunday, both lines ringing at once, and the calls that come in while they're already helping someone.
- It follows the fallback rule you chose: transfer straight to your cell, take a message and text it to you, or schedule a callback.
- AVA is an AI assistant. Demo calls are scripted samples using AVA's demo voice and sample data.
